newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended higher on Wednesday, lifted by short-covering in a move to correct the recent downward trends, traders said.
Prices ranged from 1.3 yen to 2.6 yen per kg higher. Benchmark August was up 1.5 yen at 152.3 yen.

Speculation that the Thai government will raise the price of raw materials to intervenue in the market from the current 25 baht to 27 baht per kg, also provided support to the market, the traders said. "A feeling that the prices were too low, stimulated short-covering. But it is still early for local investors to make fresh purchases," one trader said.
